segments.scene_heading: INT. JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE - NIGHT #4-1#
segments.time: Night, warm interior light from brass sconces and ceiling downlights
segments.first_state: Camera at the corridor end of the landing, facing the autumn landscape painting on the back wall. The landing has one pair of brushed-steel elevator doors on the left wall, closed. One tall walnut front door with a black smart lock stands on the right wall. One autumn landscape painting hangs above one slim console table on the back wall, between two brass wall sconces. Lu Shaoze, in his navy double-breasted suit over a black silk shirt, stands at the walnut front door, facing it, with his back to the elevator doors. Ji Ran is inside the closed elevator, about to arrive. She wears her black satin slip dress and carries the black handbag.

shots.camera: Wide shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the corridor end facing the painting
shots.visual: Lu Shaoze stands at the walnut front door and smooths his swept-back hair with one hand. The elevator doors behind him across the landing are closed.

shots.camera: Medium shot, handheld camera, eye level, from the corridor end near the elevator doors, facing the walnut front door
shots.visual: Lu Shaoze raises his knuckles and knocks on the walnut front door, smiling confidently.
shots.audio: <Knuckles knock on wood>

shots.camera: Medium shot, quick pan from the walnut front door to the elevator doors, eye level, from the corridor end
shots.visual: The elevator doors slide open and Ji Ran steps out holding the black handbag. Lu Shaoze spins around, startled, and collides with her in the middle of the landing.
shots.audio: <Elevator chime, doors slide open, a soft bump>

shots.camera: Medium close-up two-shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the corridor end facing the painting
shots.visual: The two step apart and stop beneath the autumn landscape painting, Ji Ran on the elevator side and Lu Shaoze on the front-door side. Ji Ran steadies the black handbag on her arm and glares at him.
shots.audio: <Heels click on stone>

shots.camera: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Ji Ran's shoulder, from the corridor end on the elevator side, facing Lu Shaoze
shots.visual: Lu Shaoze tilts his head with a mocking grin and spreads one hand toward Ji Ran.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lu Shaoze, in Mandarin, sneering drawl): {呀，好久不见呀，纪大小姐，您真是贵人事多，这么晚才回家呀。}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, slow push in on Ji Ran, eye level, from the corridor end on the front-door side
shots.visual: Ji Ran raises one brow and gives a cool, thin smile, her hand resting on the handbag strap.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Ran, in Mandarin, dry and cutting): {比不上路少爷您清闲，都有空在别人家门口当门神了。}

shots.camera: Close-up, clean single on Lu Shaoze, tight on his face and shoulders, locked-off camera, eye level, from the corridor end on the elevator side
shots.visual: Lu Shaoze's grin stiffens and his jaw tightens.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Ran, in Mandarin, deadpan): {怎么，路少爷这是刚回国，都找不到自己家门口在哪了？}

segments.light_audio: Warm brass sconces on either side of the painting and soft ceiling downlights; quiet building hum, elevator chime, heels on stone.

dialogue.line: 呀，好久不见呀，纪大小姐，您真是贵人事多，这么晚才回家呀。

Ji Ran steps out of the elevator and collides with Lu Shaoze
They face off beneath the autumn landscape painting
